root_cause: Composio v3.1 LinkedIn tool execution requires the connected account user_id in addition to connected_account_id. Production readback with only connected_account_id returned ActionExecute_ConnectedAccountEntityIdRequired.
prevention: Forward the exact connected account user_id on every LinkedIn Composio tool execution.
Treat missing connected-account user context as a hard configuration/runtime error rather than retrying blindly.
Persist granted LinkedIn scopes in canonical capability state without exposing tokens.
Keep company-page capability fail-closed until r_organization_admin is present and GET_COMPANY_INFO succeeds.
evidence: Composio request 2169 succeeded for LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO with user_id
Composio request 2170 returned missing r_organization_admin for company ACLs
